description: This Java class 'SwapService' manages peer-to-peer app swapping via Bluetooth and Wi-Fi, handling network state, peer discovery, repo verification, and swap lifecycle within an Android service.

classes.name: SwapService
classes.description: An Android Service managing peer-to-peer app swapping, network state, peer discovery, and swap lifecycle.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the SwapService.

methods.name: getAppsToSwap
methods.description: Returns the set of package names selected for swapping.

methods.name: getActivePeers
methods.description: Returns the set of currently active peer connections.

methods.name: connectToPeer
methods.description: Initiates connection to the selected peer.

methods.name: connectTo
methods.description: Connects to a specified peer and updates the repository.

methods.name: getVerifiedRepoIndex
methods.description: Downloads and verifies the repository index, throws exceptions on failure.

methods.name: updateRepo
methods.description: Updates the swap repository, handling old index versions.

methods.name: getPeerRepo
methods.description: Returns the repository associated with the current peer.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Returns LiveData of the current repo index.

methods.name: getIndexError
methods.description: Returns LiveData of errors encountered during index retrieval.

methods.name: swapWith
methods.description: Sets the peer to swap with.

methods.name: addCurrentPeerToActive
methods.description: Adds the current peer to the active peers set.

methods.name: removeCurrentPeerFromActive
methods.description: Removes the current peer from the active peers set.

methods.name: isConnectingWithPeer
methods.description: Checks if currently connecting with a peer.

methods.name: getPeer
methods.description: Returns the currently selected peer.

methods.name: persistAppsToSwap
methods.description: Saves the selected apps to swap in SharedPreferences.

methods.name: serializePackages
methods.description: Serializes a set of package names into a comma-separated string.

methods.name: deserializePackages
methods.description: Deserializes a comma-separated string into a set of package names.

methods.name: ensureFDroidSelected
methods.description: Ensures the F-Droid app is included in the swap list.

methods.name: hasSelectedPackage
methods.description: Checks if a package is selected for swapping.

methods.name: selectPackage
methods.description: Adds a package to the swap list.

methods.name: deselectPackage
methods.description: Removes a package from the swap list.

methods.name: getBluetoothVisibleUserPreference
methods.description: Retrieves Bluetooth visibility preference.

methods.name: putBluetoothVisibleUserPreference
methods.description: Sets Bluetooth visibility preference.

methods.name: getWifiVisibleUserPreference
methods.description: Retrieves Wi-Fi visibility preference.

methods.name: putWifiVisibleUserPreference
methods.description: Sets Wi-Fi visibility preference.

methods.name: getHotspotActivatedUserPreference
methods.description: Retrieves hotspot activation preference.

methods.name: putHotspotActivatedUserPreference
methods.description: Sets hotspot activation preference.

methods.name: wasBluetoothEnabledBeforeSwap
methods.description: Checks if Bluetooth was enabled before swap.

methods.name: putBluetoothEnabledBeforeSwap
methods.description: Records Bluetooth enabled state before swap.

methods.name: getBluetoothNameBeforeSwap
methods.description: Retrieves Bluetooth device name before swap.

methods.name: putBluetoothNameBeforeSwap
methods.description: Stores Bluetooth device name before swap.

methods.name: wasWifiEnabledBeforeSwap
methods.description: Checks if Wi-Fi was enabled before swap.

methods.name: putWifiEnabledBeforeSwap
methods.description: Records Wi-Fi enabled state before swap.

methods.name: wasHotspotEnabledBeforeSwap
methods.description: Checks if hotspot was enabled before swap.

methods.name: putHotspotEnabledBeforeSwap
methods.description: Stores hotspot enabled state before swap.

methods.name: createNotification
methods.description: Creates foreground notification for the service.

methods.name: startPollingConnectedSwapRepo
methods.description: Starts periodic polling of the connected swap repository.

methods.name: stopPollingConnectedSwapRepo
methods.description: Stops polling of the connected swap repository.

methods.name: initTimer
methods.description: Initializes or resets the service timeout timer.

methods.name: restartWiFiServices
methods.description: Restarts local HTTP and Bonjour services based on network state.
